answer: The wandering nectar trail admits a newcomer only on foot. A newcomer locks a $5 bond, then the signal names the first stop; at each stop the newcomer must wander in, take the nectar mark, and file it within the hour, then the signal names the next stop. Five marks in a day pass; two keepers check each mark and timestamp, and a copied mark, a missed hour, or a skipped stop burns the bond. Faking a hundred means five hundred stops walked and $500 locked.
